local_review.finding_body: The resolved dynamic-access report listed covered call sites in org.flywaydb.core.internal.license.VersionPrinter and org.flywaydb.core.internal.resource.classpath.ClassPathResource, but the suite had no dedicated VersionPrinterTest.java or ClassPathResourceTest.java. This violated the one-test-file-per-dynamic-access-class requirement in §FS-test-contract.1.8.
local_review.finding_title: Dynamic-access classes lacked dedicated test files
local_review.fix_note: Added dedicated VersionPrinterTest and ClassPathResourceTest coverage through the library APIs, without pinning the Flyway version or weakening existing scenarios. Forge finalization regenerated the affected test-only metadata and library statistics and then passed cleanly on rerun.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the complete coordinate-scoped diff and local evidence. The contribution stays within org.flywaydb:flyway-core:10.15.0, uses only reachability-metadata.json, and has no scaffold placeholder, Native Image dodge, version-pinned test, package overlap, legacy metadata, or unjustified native flag. Reported dynamic-access coverage is 38/39 (97.4359%), above the new-library gate, and 38 covered calls do not trigger the 293-entry mismatch threshold. After repair, the Forge finalization completed successfully with all three test lanes, metadata/style/generated-test checks, deterministic metadata routing, and refreshed statistics, with no further publishable change.
